offering_description.value: DigitalOcean sells cloud computing, storage and networking to developers, startups and smaller businesses. It runs the infrastructure and lets customers deploy resources through a web console or API. It also provides managed databases, application and website hosting, and tools for training and running AI models.

primary_products.value: Virtual cloud servers; object and block storage; virtual networking tools; GPU cloud instances; AI development software

primary_services.value: Managed databases; managed Kubernetes; managed application deployment; managed website hosting; hosted AI model training and inference

customer_segment.value: B2B: Startups, small and midsize businesses, software companies, web agencies and AI teams; B2C: Independent developers, freelancers and hobbyists

end_markets.value: Software and SaaS; web development and hosting; e-commerce; digital media and gaming; artificial intelligence

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Compute time, storage, data transfer and AI model usage; subscription: Monthly plans for hosted infrastructure, managed databases and website hosting

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Runs servers and network equipment in data centers to supply computing capacity to developers and businesses; software / platform: Pools computing resources and exposes them through a console and APIs for developers and software teams; service provider: Manages databases, application runtimes and website infrastructure for businesses and web agencies
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Worldwide customers, with data center regions in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Cloud infrastructure, managed databases, application and website hosting, GPU computing and AI model tools

distribution_channels.value: online: Self-service signup and provisioning through company websites and cloud consoles; direct sales: Sales team for businesses with larger or more complex cloud deployments; partners / resellers: Resellers and managed service providers that offer cloud infrastructure to their clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cloud hosting and personal data processing are subject to privacy rules such as GDPR and California's CCPA.
